fact: The DGCP list of tenders registered in 2024 was extracted on 26 December 2024 from the Sistema de Gestão de Concursos Públicos (SIGCP-GB), a tender-management system in service at the DGCP.
title: Lista dos concursos registado junto da DGCP 2024
